title: Scalar Gauss-Bonnet Wormholes and the Imaginary Distance Bound
summary: We study $O(4)$ symmetric Euclidean wormholes in four-dimensional gravity with a massless scalar linearly coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet invariant. At nonzero coupling, the Einstein wormhole becomes a regular complex saddle that satisfies the Kontsevich-Segal-Witten criterion until its branch ends at a finite coupling. In asymptotically flat space, the Gauss-Bonnet term modifies the scalar displacement and the on-shell action for finite wormholes, but the size dependent parts of both corrections vanish in the large throat limit.
